definitions.explanation: A small plate used to take portions from shared dishes when eating with others. Essential in Japanese dining culture where food is often served communally.

examples.japanese: {取|と}り{皿|ざら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{一|いち}{枚|まい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Could I have one more small plate, please?

examples.japanese: ⟦{大皿|おおざら}→大皿：04477_oozara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{皿|ざら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{分|わ}けた→取り分ける：22512_toriwakeru⟧。
examples.english: I portioned the food from the large platter onto individual plates.

examples.japanese: ⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{取|と}り{皿|ざら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何枚|なんまい}→何枚：08777_nanmai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: At izakaya, everyone shares dishes, so you need many individual plates.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Reflects the Japanese communal dining style where dishes are placed in the center of the table and diners take portions onto their own small plates. At restaurants, it is perfectly normal to ask the staff for extra {取|と}り{皿|ざら}. Different from a personal plate (⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧) in Western-style individual plating.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {取|と}り{皿|ざら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧ (to prepare individual plates)
- {取|と}り{皿|ざら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to put food on one's plate)
- {取|と}り{皿|ざら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧ (to clear the individual plates)
